name: mcp-use
title_zh: 一套脚手架同时长出 ChatGPT 插件和 AI 代
tagline_zh: 不用在 Claude 和 ChatGPT 两套协议间精神分裂。同一份代码，双端部署，还自带调试台和热重载。
tagline_en: Stop maintaining two codebases for Claude & ChatGPT. Write once, deploy to both, with hot reload and a built-in.
desc_en: The fullstack MCP framework to develop MCP Apps for ChatGPT / Claude & MCP Servers for AI Agents.
why_zh: 把 MCP 的客户端、服务端、传输层全封装成一套类型安全的开发体验，你只写业务逻辑，协议细节它替你扛。
why_en: Wraps client, server, and transport into one type-safe DX. You write business logic; it handles the protocol plumbing.
limit_zh: 需要 Node.js 18+ 和 TypeScript 基础；只覆盖 MCP 协议。
limit_en: Requires Node 18+ & TypeScript. Covers MCP only—no GUI or plain HTTP APIs. Debug console is local-only; auth is on you.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: One scaffold for ChatGPT plugins & MCP servers
